auth.note: The server is documented as unauthenticated and listens on localhost by default. Binding it to all interfaces exposes it to the network.

verified.notes: Port 1234 (used in every example) and the OpenAI-style API are from LM Studio's server docs. It is recognised by its native REST API, GET /api/v1/models, which answers with a models list (LM Studio 0.4.0 and later, per its docs read 2026-11-20). Older versions, or a server with its API token switched on, show up as a generic OpenAI-compatible server instead. The native list also reports max_context_length and loaded_instances per model, which are not read yet. The lms subcommands are listed by a community index of its CLI; confirm each with `lms --help` before relying on them.
